PZZ700-120915-
1212 PM PST Wed Nov 11 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1006 mb low was 250 nautical miles west of Point 
Conception and a broad 1026 mb high spread over northeastern Utah
and southwestern Wyoming. Northeast offshore flow during nights 
and mornings will alternate with northwest onshore flow during 
afternoons and evenings through Thursday. Southerly winds increase
Friday, turning westerly and strengthening Friday night into 
Saturday. Isolated thunderstorms possible over the marine waters
early Friday morning, beginning before sunrise with decreasing 
chances by Friday afternoon. Swell and wind waves will increase 
considerably at the same time. Hazardous boating conditions are 
likely Friday evening through Saturday. Winds and seas diminish 
Sunday.

$$
